# Angular close-up art

Build recognition from unequal interlocking planes and a few revealing cues,
not realistic anatomy or an ordinary image with a distressed filter.
Fill the frame until the subject approaches abstraction while remaining
recognizable. This skill is self-contained; no other art skill is required.

## Workflow

1. Establish the requested subject, person count, contact or activity, and any
   explicit palette or likeness requirements. Default to one static composition,
   not an unsolicited gallery.
2. Read [the style guide](references/style-guide.md) for construction, palette,
   surface, and inspection rules.
3. Inspect [the portrait reference](assets/styles/earth-toned-angular-portrait.png)
   for face construction, or select the closest subject from the
   [five-image learning set](references/style-guide.md#angular-hyper-closeups-set).
   For a concealed relationship or delayed second-person reading, consult the
   [retained final](#retained-finals) and
   [delayed-discovery guidance](references/style-guide.md#delayed-discovery-and-abstract-rhythm).
   Supply only relevant images to the image tool and explain each one's role.
4. Choose a broad quiet plane, smaller angular interruptions, a meaningful
   shared boundary, and a revealing subject cue. Invent a new arrangement.
   For objects, translate the construction rather than importing facial features.
5. Generate only when explicitly requested, inspect the result against the
   requested subject and the guide, and deliver the actual image or working link.
   Disclose misses rather than claiming exact fidelity.

## Reference and generation boundaries

Resolve bundled paths relative to this SKILL.md, not the current workspace.
The bundled references and finals are generated learning examples, not original source
paintings, anatomical diagrams, or permission to copy an exact composition.
Later corrections and the current request override incidental image details.
Do not infer an artist, physical medium, historical movement, or license.

When a photograph is supplied, extract its subject, activity, relationship,
and broad relative positions. Reinterpret those through angular construction;
do not preserve photographic likeness, anatomy, clothing, or camera geometry
unless explicitly requested. Once that brief is sufficient, use the bundled
artwork rather than the photograph as the generation reference. Keep personal
photographs out of the bundled assets.

Discussion, skill editing, or saving references does not authorize paid trials.
Use an available authorized image tool; report its absence instead of claiming
to have rendered artwork. Do not automatically retry failed, cancelled, or
timed-out generation. Save new outputs in the session artifact area, outside
product source. Separate requested files require separate deliverables.
Do not overwrite references, delete studies, install globally, publish, or
commit without the applicable authorization.

Keep the dusty earth palette, rubbed surface, and tightly cropped planes
separate from flowing scratchy figurative rules unless mixing is requested.

## Retained finals

These are unchanged generated paintings retained at the user's request. Transfer
the named compositional lesson, not every incidental feature or the exact layout.

| Painting | What to learn | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Hidden embrace with echoed hair planes](assets/final-paintings/hidden-embrace-echoed-hair.png) | A dominant pale face on the right balances quieter hair, ear, and nape clues on the left. Smaller upper-right planes echo the hair's hue and sweep, making the hidden head part of a larger abstract rhythm. Coral, slate teal, cream, and warm gray cross the figures instead of color-coding them. | The woman and embrace are intentionally ambiguous; use clearer cues when immediate recognition is requested. Long hair is a scoped styling choice, not proof of gender. The repetitive patterned surface is an acknowledged limitation, not the desired rubbed-pigment finish. |

Add finals only when requested; preserving an image does not authorize publication,
new generation trials, or promotion of rejected intermediate versions.

## Example requests

- `/angular-closeup-art Paint two faces touching, cropped until their contact reads through one dark seam and broad ivory planes.`
- `/angular-closeup-art Create an extreme close-up of fingers on an acoustic guitar; let strings and a sound-hole fragment identify the subject.`
- `/angular-closeup-art Paint a worn sneaker as interlocking terracotta and ivory planes, with just enough laces to reveal the object.`
